description: Find the lowest current price for one named PC game. Compares live prices across the stores it tracks (Steam, GOG, Humble Store, Fanatical, Epic Games Store and others, in US dollars) and returns the cheapest store, every store price, the lowest price on record and a buy link to hand to the user. Read only. No payment is taken and no fee is added.

game_id.description: Optional exact game id from an earlier answer.

max_price.description: Optional budget in US dollars. The answer says if the best price is within it.

max_results.description: How many store offers to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Game name, for example Elden Ring.

name: find_best_offer
title: Find the best current price for a PC game
